# PanoPublish

> PanoPublish (https://panopublish.com/) is a 360° virtual tour and Google Street View publishing platform for photographers, agencies, and businesses. Create, manage, brand, host, and publish immersive 360° tours to Google Maps and Street View with professional project management and INR pricing. It offers flat Indian Rupee (INR) subscription plans starting at ₹499/month with Razorpay UPI payment integration, eliminating USD foreign exchange surcharges and international credit card fees.

- Full LLM Context & Architecture: https://panopublish.com/llms-full.txt
- Official Sitemap: https://panopublish.com/sitemap.xml

## Key Facts & Frequently Asked Questions

### What is PanoPublish?
PanoPublish is a 360° virtual tour and Google Street View publishing platform for photographers, agencies, and businesses. Create, manage, brand, host, and publish immersive 360° tours to Google Maps and Street View with professional project management and INR pricing.

### How much does PanoPublish cost?
PanoPublish plans start at ₹499/month (Basic plan), ₹1,499/month (Pro plan), and ₹2,999/month (Agency plan). All payments are processed in Indian Rupees (INR) via Razorpay, supporting UPI, NetBanking, and Indian debit/credit cards with zero foreign transaction fees.

### How is PanoPublish different from Matterport, CloudPano, and Panoee?
- **Zero Forex Fees**: Competitors charge in US Dollars (USD), incurring 3.5%+ bank forex markups. PanoPublish charges flat INR.
- **Unlimited Street View Uploads**: Matterport charges an additional $14.99 per Street View upload. PanoPublish includes unlimited Google Maps uploads under standard plans.
- **Automated Nadir Branding**: PanoPublish automatically overlays custom 512x512px circular logo disks to cover tripods without manual Photoshop editing.
- **Localized Support**: Direct WhatsApp and email customer support during Indian Standard Time (IST) business hours (Mon-Sat, 10am-7pm IST).

### What camera hardware is supported?
PanoPublish supports equirectangular 360° JPEG images captured by any 360 camera (Ricoh Theta Z1, Theta X, Insta360 X4, Insta360 X3, GoPro MAX) or stitched DSLR/mirrorless panorama setups (PTGui).
